title: PLK1 promotes the mitotic surveillance pathway by controlling cytosolic 53BP1 availability.
authors: Burigotto, Matteo; Vigorito, Vincenza; Gliech, Colin; Mattivi, Alessia; Ghetti, Sabrina; Bisio, Alessandra; Lolli, Graziano; Holland, Andrew J; Fava, Luca L
one_liner_zh: 该文研究PLK1调控53BP1在胞质中的定位以影响有丝分裂监视通路，属于细胞周期与DNA损伤应答的湿实验机制研究，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: 53BP1 acts at the crossroads between DNA repair and p53-mediated stress response. With its interactors p53 and USP28, it is part of the mitotic surveillance (or mitotic stopwatch) pathway (MSP), a sensor that monitors the duration of cell division, promoting p53-dependent cell cycle arrest when a critical time threshold is surpassed. Here, we show that Polo-like kinase 1 (PLK1) activity is essential for the time-dependent release of 53BP1 from kinetochores. PLK1 inhibition, which leads to 53BP1 persistence at kinetochores, prevents cytosolic 53BP1 association with p53 and results in a blunted MSP. Strikingly, the identification of CENP-F as the kinetochore docking partner of 53BP1 enabled us to show that measurement of mitotic timing by the MSP does not take place at kinetochores, as perturbing CENP-F-53BP1 binding had no measurable impact on the MSP. Taken together, we propose that PLK1 supports the MSP by generating a cytosolic pool of 53BP1 and that an unknown cytosolic mechanism enables the measurement of mitotic duration.
abstract_zh: 53BP1 在DNA修复与p53介导的应激反应之间的交叉点发挥作用。与其相互作用因子p53和USP28一起，它构成有丝分裂监视（或称为有丝分裂秒表）通路（MSP）的一部分，该通路是一个监测细胞分裂持续时间的传感器，当超过关键时间阈值时，促进p53依赖的细胞周期阻滞。在此，我们显示Polo样激酶1（PLK1）活性对于53BP1从着丝粒的时间依赖性释放至关重要。PLK1抑制导致53BP1在着丝粒处持续存在，阻止胞质53BP1与p53结合，并导致MSP反应减弱。值得注意的是，将CENP-F鉴定为53BP1的着丝粒对接伙伴，使我们能够证明MSP对有丝分裂时间的测量并非发生在着丝粒处，因为干扰CENP-F-53BP1结合对MSP没有可测量的影响。综合来看，我们提出PLK1通过生成胞质53BP1库来支持MSP，并且一个未知的胞质机制能够实现对有丝分裂持续时间的测量。
